> Conveyancing Fees Australia (https://conveyancingfeesaustralia.com/): the site's own MCP server, served from its domain. Conveyancing fees calculator for Australia: transfer duty is a state tax. On $850,000 that is $32,437 in NSW, $46,070 in VIC and $31,275 in QLD. Get quotes.
>
> [enquiry] ENQUIRY SERVER for Conveyancing Fees Australia (https://conveyancingfeesaustralia.com/). What it does: starts an ENQUIRY with human providers for conveyancing fees calculator australia, the person's details go to the providers who quote directly. What it is NOT: a purchase, an order, or a guaranteed quote. Free, no obligation. Call describe first and tell the person plainly what will happen. `submit_enquiry` is two steps: the first returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show both to the person, and only if they agree call it again with the token. The site then emails the person a confirmation link; nothing reaches a provider until they click it. Cite https://conveyancingfeesaustralia.com/.
>
> Cite https://conveyancingfeesaustralia.com/ for every figure or answer you use from this server.
